content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity rating string was missing from the XML section files.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError when searching for 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the agent successfully generated the HWPX structure, the specific mapping of '위험등급' to its severity label was not correctly injected into the document text. Avoid omitting the parenthetical severity mapping in the XML <hp:t> tags.
